program.section_heading: ENGLISH FOR CITIZENSHIP, CERTIFICATE OF COMPETENCY
outcomes: Converse and engage at a functional level adequate for responding to verbal questions related to personal history, U.S. history, geography, and culture, and general knowledge of U.S. governmental structure.

Comprehend and report aural and written information demonstrating knowledge of the citizenship process, the rights and responsibilities of U.S. citizens, U.S. history, geography, and culture, and U.S. governmental structure sufficient to pass the United States Citizenship Exam.
Write dictated sentences legibly demonstrating knowledge of sentence structure, grammar, capitalization, and spelling rules at the higher-elementary level.

notes: Noncredit Certificate of Competency (CDCP). The catalog states the award in units ('Total Units: 0.0 Units') and prints no hours, so measure is 'units' and the printed totals of 0 are recorded as stated. Hours of instruction are not given in the text.
The block sits inside an outer 'English for Citizenship (Total 0) Complete all of the following' wrapper. It is recorded as one 'all' block.
ELW910 (English for Citizenship I) is required by the catalog but is not in the closed list. It is marked as a catalog addition.
Award instructions require completing both courses with progress indicators of P or SP.

The lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' also appears once before the section heading with no outcomes under it. The outcomes are taken from the Program Learning Outcomes heading.
